usageNote: 动词短语！用来说探索时有意外惊喜，语气带点兴奋感，日常聊天超常用～

examples.en: When you travel alone, you discover much more interesting things than on a tour.
examples.zh: 独自旅行时，你会发现比跟团更多有趣的事。

examples.en: Read widely and you'll discover much more interesting things about the world.
examples.zh: 广泛阅读，你会发现这个世界更多有趣的事物。
